spatial_operating_summary.note: Synthetic 0.1--0.4N operating-band screen; 0.025N is a diagnostic, not an uncalibrated pass/fail requirement.

unloading_recovery.warning: No permanent set, debonding, fatigue or hysteresis modeled; calibrate tau, moduli and strain range using real load/unload tests.

observability.assumption: Independent synthetic capacitive/Hall readouts, no calibration; measured hardware may have lower effective rank.

force_reconstruction.training: Ridge on synthetic signals; fixed seed, independently generated positions, no real-world generalization claim

screening_metrics.physics: 6DOF composite-rod surrogate with PVDF membrane and bond shear-lag; not calibrated / not nonlinear FEM
screening_metrics.electric_response_status: Assumed electrostatic/magnetic transfer; no field solving or actual circuit noise.
screening_metrics.piezo_model: PVDF multi-channel d31/d33 + RC highpass, small-displacement beam strain surrogate, assumed noise
screening_metrics.score_explanation: Weighted engineering utility of approximate geometry, assumed SNR, piezo transient response and nuisance sensitivity; NOT a success probability, accuracy or FEM outcome.

hybrid_stage_screen.note: Two series stages, independent electrodes. Two channels alone cannot identify Fx,Fy,Fz uniquely.

limitations: 6-DOF beam proxy; no hyperelasticity or real contact FEM
synthetic electrical response and assumed noise (not measured)
STL is an assembly visualization, not a printable watertight union
strain and manufacturing thresholds are tentative design assumptions
Unloading recovery uses an assumed standard-linear-solid compliance, not viscoelastic FEM or experimental calibration
FEM solver is explicit (HEX8 solid or 3D space-frame beam); neither includes hyperelasticity nor true contact physics.

fem.mesh_warning: 15/15 flexures had radius below 1.44 mm and were inflated by voxel resolution.

fem_capacitor_assumption.note: Top-pad FEM displacement is NOT resolved capacitor-dielectric compression; synthetic gap transfer only.

hybrid_stages.source: Connected HEX8 stage displacement samples and normalized 3-axis mechanical transfer; no sensor calibration

limitations: Post-processed thin-ribbon shell, not a fully coupled shell-solid contact solve

notes: Real 3-D linear HEX8 displacement/strain/stress solve on voxelized struts
